recent_weekly_summaries.thesis: Semiconductor sector profit-taking after record H1 creates rotation. MU likely stopped out at -5% from late-June entry (~$1,133→$975, -14% drawdown). AMD replaces MU as AI compute play — #1 momentum scorer (RS60=+66%, Data Center $5.8B +57% YoY, OpenAI+Meta 6GW GPU deployments, earnings Aug 4). AMAT holds through equipment-sector correction (stop $391 far from $603 current, supercycle intact). LLY holds on Medicare GLP-1 Bridge July 1 launch success.

close_reasons.MU: Stop likely triggered at ~$1,076 (-5% from ~$1,133 entry); price hit $975 by July 2 (-14% from entry range). AI memory thesis intact long-term — watchlist for re-entry above $1,050.
